lines.q: Which has more people, Egypt or Germany?
lines.a: Egypt! Around one hundred eighteen million, over thirty million more.
Bangladesh! About one hundred seventy six million, in a country about the size of Iowa.
Canada! About forty million. Just two million more than Poland.
Pakistan! About two hundred fifty five million, the fifth biggest in the world. Think you can get all four? Go again!
